question: Where’s the closest restaurant forward of Lucille Ball Childhood Home, Jamestown, NY in the direction of Tidioute Overlook, Tidioute, PA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lucille Ball Childhood Home%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Tidioute Overlook%' LIMIT 1 ), target_azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_az FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s, target_azimuth_calc tac WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 0 -- Ensure it's not the starting point itself AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the direction from the start point to the restaurant -- and the target direction (start point to end point). -- The expression normalizes the difference to be between -180 and 180 degrees, -- then checks if its absolute value is within 45 degrees (a 90-degree cone). ABS( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, p.geometry)) - tac.target_az + 540) % 360 - 180 ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
